آتنس (form VIII)

# آتَنِسَ (ʔātanisa) /ʔaː.ta.ni.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
# آتَنِسْ (ʔātanis) /ʔaː.ta.nis/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
